$comment: Where the launcher's state home is: the directory that holds tokens.json (and the launcher's own stack.json and discovery/kbs.json). Every program that finds those files computes it the same way. `os` is `macos` or anything else; `home` is the home directory (HOME, or USERPROFILE on Windows), `xdgStateHome` is XDG_STATE_HOME; null means not set. `dir` null means there is no state home, and nothing is read or written. Rust (packages/sdk-rust: sign_in_store::state_dir) runs every case; it is given what the environment says and reads none itself. The launcher's Go (apps/launcher/internal/launcher: stateDirFor) runs every case too, and StateDir reads the environment for it.

cases.why: elsewhere, XDG_STATE_HOME when it is set
an empty XDG_STATE_HOME is one that is not set
with no home there is no state home, even where XDG_STATE_HOME is set
an empty home is no home
macOS with no home has no state home
